I replied to Ilse in the #north-random thread. I confirmed that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats and said I hadn't changed anything, since she asked for no action. I also suggested she post the correction in #north-team herself so people there see it.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, and she had already posted it in #north-random, so it was fine to repeat it there. I didn't read #north-team, and my reply doesn't mention the number she posted there this morning.
